A '''skirmish''' occurred at the [[Farpoint Medical Center]] on [[Fhost]] when [[Jaden Korr]] received word that the [[Community]] of maddened clones wrought havoc at the [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] in [[Farpoint]]. He tried to capture them, but they escaped aboard a [[Unidentified medical supply ship|medical supply ship]]
